feature: Deferred native configuration reload after quiescence
semantics: Default reload behavior still rejects busy affected Agents unless --when-idle is supplied
Waiting records the operation and fingerprint, while existing/new work, FIFO, reply delivery and callback continuation keep progressing
Periodic revalidation requires all existing blocker checks to clear before workspace preparation and provider retirement begin
New submissions may extend waiting indefinitely; this is deferred application, not a closed admission drain
Exact operation ID cancels only the still-waiting configuration change, never Agent tasks; repeated cancellation is idempotent until superseded
Normal shutdown marks waiting reload interrupted; a restarted daemon also marks a still-waiting receipt interrupted and retains committed old configuration
Desired configuration secrets are kept in memory, not copied into the reload journal; applying after a restart requires a new explicit request
ProjectView reports waiting state and admission_paused separately
